PLANES_PAGE.FAQ_Q1: Can I change my plan at any time?

PLANES_PAGE.FAQ_Q5: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
PLANES_PAGE.FAQ_A5: Yes, you can cancel at any time without penalties. You'll keep access to paid features until the end of the billing period and then automatically switch to the Free plan.

PLANES_PAGE.FAQ_A7: Kakebo is a Japanese personal financial management method that involves recording all your income and expenses divided into categories (survival, leisure, culture and unexpected) to become aware of your spending habits and save progressively.

ACERCA_PAGE.TITLE: About
ACERCA_PAGE.SUBTITLE: We are the team of web developers behind Nexora. We create tools that transform people's relationship with their finances.
ACERCA_PAGE.MISION_DESC: Democratise financial education and provide accessible tools that enable anyone to take control of their personal finances, regardless of their previous experience.
ACERCA_PAGE.VISION_DESC: To be the leading platform for personal financial management in the Spanish-speaking world, creating a community where users improve their financial habits with the support of intelligent technology and professional content.
ACERCA_PAGE.VALORES_SUBTITLE: The principles that guide every decision we make.
ACERCA_PAGE.VAL_1_DESC: Your financial data is sacred. We never share it with third parties or use it for advertising.
ACERCA_PAGE.VAL_2_DESC: We believe financial education should be accessible to everyone. That's why we offer a free plan with no time limit.
ACERCA_PAGE.VAL_3_DESC: We integrate artificial intelligence with Kiro to offer personalised recommendations and a unique experience.
ACERCA_PAGE.VAL_4_DESC: Clear pricing, no hidden costs. Honest communication with our community at all times.
ACERCA_PAGE.TEAM_SUBTITLE: The team of web developers building Nexora
ACERCA_PAGE.MEMBER_1_BIO: Committed to code quality and user experience that defines Nexora.
ACERCA_PAGE.MEMBER_2_BIO: Specialised in frontend architecture and creating attractive and functional interfaces.
ACERCA_PAGE.MEMBER_3_BIO: Focused on robust backend and system integration that brings Nexora to life.
ACERCA_PAGE.MEMBER_4_BIO: Passionate about technological innovation and creating accessible financial solutions.
ACERCA_PAGE.STORY_P1: Nexora arose from a real need: we wanted a tool that would not only track expenses, but help us understand our financial habits and improve them.
ACERCA_PAGE.STORY_P2: Inspired by the Japanese Kakebo method, we decided to create a modern platform that combined monitored transaction tracking with educational content created by economic sector professionals.
ACERCA_PAGE.STORY_P3: Today, Nexora integrates artificial intelligence with Kiro, offers monthly challenges that encourage good habits and connects users through our economics and finance forum.

POLITICA_PAGE.TITLE: Privacy policy
POLITICA_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Your privacy is our priority. Read how we protect and use your data.
POLITICA_PAGE.S1_DESC: At Nexora we collect the information necessary to provide you with our personal financial management services:
POLITICA_PAGE.S1_LI1: Registration data: name, email address and encrypted password.
POLITICA_PAGE.S1_LI2: Financial data: expenses and income you voluntarily enter on the platform.
POLITICA_PAGE.S1_LI3: Usage data: information about how you use Nexora to improve our services.
POLITICA_PAGE.S1_LI4: Payment data: in case of paid subscription, processed securely by external payment gateways.
POLITICA_PAGE.S2_DESC: We use your data exclusively to:
POLITICA_PAGE.S2_LI1: Provide you with Nexora services (transaction tracking, statistics, forum, challenges).
POLITICA_PAGE.S2_LI2: Personalise Kiro's recommendations, our AI financial advisor.
POLITICA_PAGE.S2_LI3: Improve and optimise the user experience on the platform.
POLITICA_PAGE.S2_LI4: Send you account-related communications and, with your consent, our newsletter.
POLITICA_PAGE.S3_DESC: The security of your data is our top priority:
POLITICA_PAGE.S3_LI1: We use AES-256 encryption to protect your financial data.
POLITICA_PAGE.S3_LI3: Passwords are stored hashed with secure algorithms.
POLITICA_PAGE.S4_DESC: We never sell or share your personal or financial data with third parties. We may only share information in the following cases:
POLITICA_PAGE.S4_LI1: With essential service providers (hosting, payment gateways) under strict confidentiality agreements.
POLITICA_PAGE.S4_LI2: When required by law or competent authorities.
POLITICA_PAGE.S5_DESC: We retain your data for as long as you keep your Nexora account active. If you decide to delete your account:
POLITICA_PAGE.S5_LI1: All your personal and financial data will be deleted within a maximum of 30 days.
POLITICA_PAGE.S5_LI2: Anonymised data for general statistics may be retained.
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_DESC: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_LI1: Access: request a copy of your personal data.
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_LI2: Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_LI3: Erasure: request the deletion of your data.
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_LI4: Portability: receive your data in a structured and readable format.
POLITICA_PAGE.S6_LI5: Objection: object to data processing in certain circumstances.
POLITICA_PAGE.S7_DESC: Nexora uses strictly necessary technical cookies for the platform to function. We do not use advertising tracking cookies or share browsing data with advertising networks.
POLITICA_PAGE.S8_DESC: If you have questions about our privacy policy or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us at:
